snippet.title: Cursflip - Your New System Cursor! | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Cursflip – a completely new type of game from Tidle Studio where your system cursor becomes the star of the show! ⚡

Replace your boring default cursor with unique, animated, rare and legendary cursors that drop every 2 hours. Collect hundreds of stunning designs – from cute and funny to Legendary and Mythical cursors. 

Trade them with other players or sell them directly on the Steam Community Market and turn your collection into real profit! 💰

Every cursor is yours forever – it works globally across your entire Windows system, in games, browsers, everywhere.

🔥 Download Cursflip on Steam NOW and start collecting Cursors!

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4033920/Cursflip/

Join the cursor revolution. Your perfect cursor is waiting.

#Cursflip #CursorGame #Steam #TidleStudio
